title: Mortgage Rates Rise for 7 Weeks: What Buyers Face
description:
U.S. mortgage rates have risen for seven straight weeks, tightening the squeeze on homebuyers in reporting published October 8, 2026. We explain that streak, the reported three-year rate high, and why borrowing costs matter alongside a home's asking price. The takeaway is to compare the monthly payment, not just the listing price; these reports alone do not establish a nationwide housing crash. What mortgage rate were you quoted, and in which state?

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
